summary_md: **Jeffrey Bander MD ([@jeffBander](https://x.com/jeffBander/status/2116112299677130811))** cites *Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents* ([arXiv 2610.21270](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21270)): small local models scored 0.91 on clean tasks but 0.00 when sources conflicted, so his design lets the model propose while tested code decides and escalates to a human.
